findings.evidence: the validator rejects any value below 1000, but no default value is stated anywhere on the page
findings.fix: Add the actual default value for timeout, for example "the default is 5000 milliseconds," so the advice to leave it at default is actionable.
findings.location: timeout section, first paragraph, second sentence
findings.violation: The document tells readers that leaving timeout at its default is the right choice, without ever stating what that default value is.

findings.evidence: raising it is worth doing only when a specific integration needs the extra room
findings.fix: Name which integrations typically need a longer timeout and suggest a concrete value or range for each case.
findings.violation: The guidance for when to raise timeout is vague and unquantified, naming no specific integrations and no target value or range to raise it to.

findings.evidence: only a minimum of 1000 milliseconds is documented for timeout, with no maximum mentioned anywhere in the section
